decisions.reason: After an extra year, this less core billing-oriented software is more likely to be judged against rising aspirations in a growing market, and if traction has remained modest management would reallocate resources to more central operational and safety offerings or new development.
Its strong fit with data-driven monitoring, installed equipment, and lifecycle service complementarities means it is likely still meeting or close enough to aspirations to justify continued support.

Although the firm has shown it will prune adjacent software that underperforms, this module remains close to the core apron coordination offer and can still be carried with current organisational slack while market acceptance becomes clearer.

Because safety-related services are highly consistent with the firm's value proposition and customer relationships, management would likely retain it unless results fall clearly below aspiration levels.
